name: Team
description: Run a team of Claude tabs on cc-cockpit Rooms: start a team, hire members from a kickoff file, hear their questions, watch cost and time, export the result. A tool, not a flow. Needs cc-cockpit 0.22.0 (Rooms from 0.19.1).
author: Oleg Bronzov

cli.name: team
cli.summary: Start and run a team of Claude tabs (one room)
cli.usage: team start "<title>" [--as <name>] | hire <name> --kickoff <file> [--model m] [--effort e] [--cwd dir] [--env NAME=value]... [--coordinator] | invite <name> [--coordinator] | fire <name> | ask "<question>" | ask - | mark "<label>" | list [--json] | stats [--json] | end [--export <dir>] | help

exportDir.title: Export folder
exportDir.description: Where `ccc team end` writes the export of a team (a new folder per team). Empty: no export unless --export names a folder.

layout.title: Layout of hired members
layout.description: Where a hire's tab opens. Later members, or when the app cannot place one, open as plain tabs.

oneOf.title: Coordinator left, members stacked on the right
Grid: right, below, below the first
